steps: UI: test wallet m4Ac… on /create/: name, description, project URL, category, goal 1000000000 (lamports), submit (create)
UI: home page lists the campaign; Contribute on its card (donate 0.2 SOL; the app sends it to the connected wallet's own campaign)
Script: test wallet withdraws the 0.2 SOL back from its campaign (the app has no withdraw screen)
Script: fund A 0.08 and B 0.04 SOL
Script: A creates its campaign (target 1 SOL; the PDA is ["CROWDFUND", admin], 9000 bytes)
Script: B donates 0.02 SOL to A's campaign
Script: return unspent SOL to the payer
evidence.functional_evidence: The hosted Contribute button always donates a fixed 0.2 SOL to the connected wallet's own campaign (PDA derived from the wallet, not the card), and the app has no withdraw screen. The program itself can donate to any campaign and withdraw, as the script shows.

limitations: Contribute always donates a fixed 0.2 SOL to the connected wallet's own campaign (CampaignCard.tsx derives the PDA from the wallet, not from the card), so in the app you can only fund yourself, and only once you have created a campaign. The program itself accepts donations to any campaign, as the script shows.
The app has no withdraw screen; withdrawal works only from a script.

Amounts on the cards are wrong: the app shows BN.words[0], the low 26 bits of the lamport value, so a 1 SOL goal shows as $60475904 and 0.2 SOL raised as $65782272. 'Remaining Days 30' is a fixed placeholder and the section title always says '3 Active Campaigns'.
Admin errors reuse generic ProgramError codes (IncorrectProgramId for 'not the admin'), and there is no deadline and no refund. The target is informational only.
One campaign per wallet: the PDA is seeded only by the admin's key.
The home page lists every account the program owns via getProgramAccounts on each load.
